structure_rules: Exactly one matching scope JSON marker, together with actual successful foreground command exit and stdout/stderr EOF.
nonce is canonical UUID v4; each slot and each helper reader ID is canonical UUID v4.
pinned_elf_sha256, root_snapshot.service_image_sha256 and root_snapshot.engine_image_sha256 equal the exact frozen libtest ELF hash.
root_service_pid and engine_pid are distinct integers >1; snapshot service_pid/engine_pid match them.
actual_helper_pids is exactly two distinct integers >1, neither equal to root service PID or engine PID.
root_snapshot.root_caps is an integer with both bit21 SYS_ADMIN and bit19 SYS_PTRACE set.
root_snapshot.slots has exactly two distinct slot IDs: one published true and one false.
published slot helpers has exactly two distinct canonical reader IDs and distinct PIDs; both exited=true; their PID set exactly equals actual_helper_pids.
cancelled slot helpers is empty; root/baseline/operation are null; published slot root is an absolute /run/rudder-managed-seeds/*/seed path.
published slot seed, baseline and operation equal engine seed, baseline and operation respectively; cancelled slot seed equals engine seed.
seed is a valid Directory ObjectRef (kind/raw SHA256/size), raw SHA256 canonical lower hex; 0<size_bytes<=262144.
published and cancelled root_cas_identity and engine.source_cas_identity are pairs of nonnegative integers and all three pairs are distinct.
Both root_cas paths are distinct absolute root-controlled /run/rudder-root-storage/*/cas paths; neither aliases engine CAS.
engine baseline and new_baseline are valid commit identities; new commit/change/tree all differ, new parents exactly [original baseline commit]; new_operation differs from original operation.
Service and engine remain alive with actual retained carriers; VM teardown is required after foreground settlement. This is never normal service retirement/cleanup.
